decisions.reason: The necessary GPIO3-to-GPIO5 change is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including both enable_gpio and led_standby_power_policy.
Changing the GPIO controlling the shared 5V enable signal does not alter the daughterboard's LED count, LED type, board form, or selected LED part.
The interboard connector continues to carry the 5V_EN signal on pin 7; changing the ESP32 GPIO behind that named signal does not change the connector interface or pinout.
The source changes control of the separate 5V boost rail and does not alter DCDC1's 3.3V output, current rating, or normal-operation loads.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V regulator, its activation condition, rail coverage, or source-selection behavior.

The charge-status interface still uses the SK6812 chain on GPIO13 and the specified external charge-LED circuit; changing the shared 5V rail's enable GPIO does not modify those interface requirements.
The source does not change USB D+/D- routing, USB enumeration behavior, connector sourcing, or the interboard USB pins.
The GPIO reassignment for 5V_EN does not alter the AXP2101 battery input, its role as the normal-operation source, or its system load coverage.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that records 5V_EN on GPIO5 together with the SCL0 and SPI MOSI reassignments, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The source confirms the WROOM-1 module context but does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module; the candidate's same-message module_variant Event already captures that separate clause.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment is unrelated to the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, part number, or unresolved battery pin order.
The source changes a controller GPIO assignment and does not alter BOM completeness, component population, charge-LED parts, or sourcing requirements.
